key_insight: MANDALA learns electronic-structure operators with E(3)-equivariant GNNs, enabling direct prediction of quantum observables beyond energies and forces.
engineering_relevance: This framework can extend scalable materials modeling to band structures, densities of states, charge distributions, and other electronic properties needed in computational chemistry and materials design.
method: Unified learning of block-sparse Hamiltonian, overlap, and density matrices
E(3)-equivariant graph neural network workflow with modular abstractions for basis conversion, sparse blocks, and irrep mapping
Observable-guided evaluation from predicted operators, including band energy, electron count, DOS, and band structure
evidence_signal: The abstract describes direct evaluation of electronic observables from predicted operators and positions the framework as a scalable implementation across multiple electronic-structure backends.
watch_item: Performance and transferability will depend on basis choice, sparse operator representation, and the quality of training data for heterogeneous chemistries.
paper_title: MANDALA: An E(3)-Equivariant Graph Neural Network Framework for Learning Electronic-Structure Operators with Observable Guidance
